may_not: claim sealed truth without vault lineage

do_not_use_when: Need immutable civilizational seal — use arif_seal (L6 write path).
Need live web evidence — use arif_observe.
arifos_manifest.eureka_insight: Memory is not truth until provenance-bound. Truth is not final until sealed (L6 VAULT999).

mode_purpose.attest: Attest integrity of a memory or seal lineage.
mode_purpose.audit: Audit memory scope / policy / lineage for a query or memory_id.
mode_purpose.forget: Tombstone a memory. F13 — human ack required for hard forget.
mode_purpose.inspect: Inspect a single memory_id or aspect without mutation.
mode_purpose.metabolize: Metabolize evidence/receipts into a unified 6-class L1-L5 mind state.
mode_purpose.promote: Promote memory across tiers (requires floors + often human_approval).
mode_purpose.recall: Semantic / hybrid recall across memory tiers.
mode_purpose.remember: Write a new provisional memory with provenance.

purpose: Governed L1–L6 semantic recall, storage, promotion, revision, and forget.
Preserve epistemic labels across memory lifecycle.

risk.note: forget with hard tombstone can be irreversible → human_approval required.

use_when: Need prior session/decision context before reasoning or judging.
Store a provisional memory with truth_class and provenance.

description: Access and maintain persistent institutional knowledge across sessions. Modes: recall (retrieve relevant context), inspect (audit stored decisions), remember (store verified lesson). Mutations to permanent tiers require explicit approval. Outputs: scoped memory entries.

actor_id.description: Your agent identity, e.g. 'kimi-code/FI-008' — recorded in the audit log.

content.description: The text to store (mode=remember) — write it as a self-contained lesson or fact.

human_approval.description: Set true ONLY when the human owner explicitly approved this promote/forget — the gate refuses without it.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key (e.g. 'memo-42'); retries with the same key will not store duplicates.

lease_id.description: Id of a short-lived permission grant (lease) authorizing this write, when one was issued to you.

memory_id.description: UUID of the memory entry to inspect/revise/forget — it was returned when the memory was created or last listed.

mode.description: 'recall' (default) — semantic search of stored memories; 'inspect' — read one memory in full; 'attest' — vouch for a memory's accuracy; 'remember' — store new text; 'promote' — move a memory up a tier; 'revise' — replace a memory's text; 'forget' — remove a memory (gated); 'audit' — integrity scan; 'metabolize' — compact and consolidate tiers.

new_content.description: Replacement text for the memory (mode=revise) — must refer to the same memory_id.

payload.description: Extra mode-specific fields as JSON — e.g. {"truth_class": "DERIVED", "provenance": "CI log"} for remember.

query.description: What to search for, in plain language (mode=recall/audit), e.g. 'past deploy rollback steps'.

session_id.description: Session id returned by arif_init; attributes this call to your governed session.

session_token.description: Session Continuity Token (SCT) returned by arif_init — proves the session is yours.

tier.description: Which memory tier to target, 'L1'–'L6' (L1 = hot working memory, L6 = sealed canon).

trace_id.description: Correlation id of your choosing (e.g. 'req-8f3a') to find this call later in the logs.
